title: Core Concurrency, Synchronization & Coordination Architecture
description: Canonical architecture governing concurrency, execution contexts, parallelism, coordination, synchronization, structured concurrency, task groups, execution ownership, execution domains, isolation, cancellation, backpressure, work stealing, visibility, and fairness in the Gordon Core.

Controls admission of participants to coordination

architecture_invariants.description: Synchronization primitives never own runtime state
